resumo: What to bring, how much travelling time she can take, and how not to come home without a single photo of the three of you.

itens: Near beats beautiful. Three hours in the car with stops is a comfortable limit in the first months.
A place with a kitchen is worth more than a place with a pool.
If you fly, a flight at her sleep time usually goes better than an early one.
Clothes for twice as many days. Something always happens.
Regular medication, prescriptions and the vaccination record.
A familiar toy and a blanket from home: the familiar smell helps with sleeping in a strange bed.
A bin bag and wet wipes in every corner: backpack, car, handbag.

secoes.titulo: The photos that are missing afterwards
itens: The photo of the three of you together. Ask a stranger, even if you cannot be bothered. You come home from every trip with only the photos you took yourself.
The landscape photo with her tiny in the corner, to give scale.
A ten second video every day, unedited. Together they make the best summary of the trip.
